summary: Aggregates wheel forces across all 4 wheels of the receiver vehicle for a given surface type a2, weighted by a speed parameter a3 clamped to 32.0. Wheels are selected by matching the surface-type field at (+84 struct, +48) of their contact entry to a2. Each selected wheel contributes force v23 = clamp(a3) * entry[39] * 0.0000038146973, accumulating a total, a speed-weighted term (a3*0.00390625 + 0.80000001) * v23, and a 3-component direction from entries 55/54/53. The result is normalized by 1/total and stored via PerIndexStructFieldSetter(a2, 1, intensity, weighted-average, &direction) when the maximum force exceeds 0.001.

operations.description: Zero-initialize the accumulators (v3, v4, v5, v7, v10, v15, v17/v18/v19).
Walk the wheel contact array starting at this + 13928 (this+0x3668), 4 entries at a float stride of 62, counting down a do-while counter from 4.
Per-entry gate: the entry pointer is non-null AND the surface-type field ((entry+84 struct) + 48) equals a2 before the wheel is aggregated.
Clamp the speed parameter to 32.0, then compute per-wheel force v23 = clamped * entry[39] * 0.0000038146973 and track the running maximum v15.
Accumulate total force v3 += v23, speed-weighted term v4 += (a3 * 0.00390625 + 0.80000001) * v23, and direction components v5/v7/v10 += v23 * entry[55]/entry[54]/entry[53].
Pack the accumulated direction components into the output slots v17 (x), v18 (y), v19 (z).
If the maximum force v15 > 0.001, compute the reciprocal 1.0/total, normalize the direction components by it, clamp the intensity to 1.0 when v15 exceeds 1.0, and normalize the weighted term.
Store the result with PerIndexStructFieldSetter(a2, 1, intensity, normalized-weighted-average, (int)&direction).
